name: Valorant
author: rockslol
description: Rank, RR, matches and rounds, the store with a wishlist, a Tab panel in matches and quieter Spotify while you play. Reads the Riot Client on this PC.

network: the Riot Client on this PC

settings.label: Tab panel
settings.hint: Hold Tab in a match for today, this map, this agent and your last match. Needs Windowed Fullscreen

settings.label: Tab panel height
settings.hint: How far down the screen it sits. Raise it for Skirmish, lower it for 5v5

settings.label: Match result alert
settings.hint: Win or loss, score and RR in the notch right after a match

settings.label: Wishlist alert
settings.hint: The notch tells you when a skin on your wishlist is in your store
